Elena (People Ops): Quick FYI — we've refreshed the OKR + self-review templates for the upcoming cycle. Pls skim and flag anything missing: https://redwoodinference.docs/okrs/q2-2026
Matt (Eng Manager): Thanks Elena — is there a short manager checklist? Trying to roll this out in team sync next week.
Elena (People Ops): Yep. Short checklist in the doc but TL:DR: 1) set 3–5 team OKRs, 2) each owner lists metrics/acceptance, 3) label goals as Committed/Stretch, 4) add 1 development goal per person.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — self-reviews open on 2026-04-01.
Sara (IC, ML): Can you paste a tiny self-review prompt? I get stuck on wording.
Elena (People Ops): Sure — micro-template you can copy:
````
What I accomplished this quarter (3–5 bullets)
Impact / metrics (numbers if possible)
Roadblocks and key learnings
Where I want to focus next quarter
Support I need from my manager
````
Dylan (Manager): Do managers need to add a written summary or just the form rating?
Elena (People Ops): Both. Please add a 1–2 paragraph manager note + suggested rating. Use the "Manager notes" field in the form and record the 1:1 date.
Matt (Eng Manager): Any guidance on how specific OKRs for infra teams should be? We often have long-running work.
Elena (People Ops): For cross-team or long projects: break into quarterly milestones and pick measurable signals per milestone (latency p50, cost per token, deployment cadence, etc.). If you can't measure it, add a proxy metric.
Sara (IC, ML): How strict are Committed vs Stretch labels? I worry folks will game it.
Elena (People Ops): We use labels to set expectations. Committed = what you plan to deliver this quarter. Stretch = upside if things go well. Managers should calibrate in 1:1s.
Matt (Eng Manager): Cool. I'll run a 20-min OKR clinic in next all-hands to show examples.
Elena (People Ops): Deadlines: self-reviews due 2026-04-10; manager reviews due 2026-04-17. If your team needs an alternate timeline, DM me with justification.
Dylan (Manager): Can we get a quick rubric for ratings to ensure managers are aligned?
Elena (People Ops): Yes — short rubric in the doc. Copy here: 
- Exceeds: Consistently delivered above expectations; clear impact.
- Meets: Delivered expected outcomes; solid execution.
- Needs Improvement: Missed key outcomes or inconsistent execution.
Also add examples for IC/Manager tracks.
people-ops-bot: Calendar event created — 'Self-review deadline (company)' 2026-04-10 09:00 — added to company calendar.
Matt (Eng Manager): Thanks all. I'll ping when I've scheduled team clinics. :thumbsup:
Elena (People Ops): Great — ping me with any questions. If helpful, here's a one-click copy of the one-page shareable for teams: https://redwoodinference.docs/okrs/one-pager-q2-2026 :sparkles:
